name: tensorspine-editor
description: TensorSpine Editor — the workspace root: the language core, the store, the interface and the static application.

scripts.test: vitest run --project lang --project store --project ui --project snapshot
scripts.build: pnpm run vendor && pnpm --filter @tensorspine/web run build
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:parity && pnpm run test:snapshot && pnpm run audit:rules && pnpm run test:e2e
